title: Senior Data Engineer ( 4+ years Exp.)
description:
#### **Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Data Engineer** with 4+ years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and modern data platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise in Python, SQL, ETL/ELT, Databricks, Snowflake, Apache Airflow, cloud data engineering, and enterprise data governance.

The candidate will be responsible for building robust data pipelines, implementing lakehouse and data warehouse architectures, orchestrating complex workflows, optimizing data processing performance, and ensuring data quality, security, and compliance.

Experience with **Microsoft Purview, metadata management, data lineage, and data governance frameworks** is highly desirable.

The role requires collaboration with data architects, analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, governed, and analytics-ready data solutions.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, SQL, PySpark, and modern data engineering technologies.
* Build and optimize data processing solutions using Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and lakehouse architecture.
* Design, develop, and manage Snowflake data warehouse solutions, including data ingestion, transformation, performance optimization, and cost management.
* Develop, schedule, and orchestrate complex data pipelines using Apache Airflow, including DAG development, task dependencies, scheduling, retries, and failure handling.
* Integrate Airflow with Databricks, Snowflake, cloud storage, APIs, databases, and other data services.
* Implement batch and near-real-time data pipelines integrating relational databases, REST APIs, third-party applications, and cloud platforms.
* Implement incremental data loading, Change Data Capture (CDC), schema evolution, data partitioning, and data synchronization.
* Design dimensional data models, star schemas, slowly changing dimensions (SCD), and analytical data structures.
* Establish data quality checks, validation rules, reconciliation processes, and automated pipeline monitoring.
* Implement data governance, metadata management, data lineage, data cataloging, and data classification using Microsoft Purview and related tools.
* Configure data discovery, sensitive data classification, business glossaries, and data asset documentation.
* Support data ownership, data stewardship, access governance, and least-privilege access principles.
* Optimize SQL queries, Spark jobs, Snowflake workloads, and cloud infrastructure costs.
* Implement CI/CD, automated testing, version control, and deployment workflows for data engineering solutions.
* Troubleshoot production data issues, perform root-cause analysis, and ensure pipeline reliability.
* Conduct code reviews, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to data engineering architecture and best practices.

#### **Required Technical Skills**

**A. Programming & Data Processing**

* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Hands-on experience with PySpark and Apache Spark.
* Experience developing and maintaining production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Knowledge of incremental processing, CDC, data validation, and performance tuning.
* Ability to write reusable, maintainable, and well-tested code.

**B. Databricks**

* Hands-on experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL, and Delta Lake.
* Understanding of Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers in medallion architecture.
* Experience with Delta tables, partitioning, optimization, and incremental data processing.
* Experience developing and maintaining data engineering workloads in Databricks.
* Familiarity with Databricks Workflows and Unity Catalog is desirable.

**C. Snowflake**

* Hands-on experience with Snowflake data warehousing and Snowflake SQL.
* Understanding of Snowflake architecture, databases, schemas, tables, and virtual warehouses.
* Experience with data loading, transformation, query optimization, and workload cost management.
* Knowledge of Snowpipe, Streams, Tasks, and Change Data Capture concepts.
* Familiarity with Snowpark, role-based access control (RBAC), and Snowflake security features.

**D. Apache Airflow & Workflow Orchestration**

* Hands-on experience developing and maintaining Apache Airflow DAGs for production data pipelines.
* Strong understanding of DAG design, task dependencies, scheduling, operators, sensors, retries, and error handling.
* Experience integrating Airflow with Databricks, Snowflake, cloud storage, databases, and APIs.
* Knowledge of backfills, catchup behavior, idempotency, and dependency management.
* Experience monitoring DAG execution, troubleshooting failed tasks, and configuring alerts.
* Understanding of Airflow connections, variables, secrets management, and environment-specific configurations.
* Familiarity with Airflow deployment, CI/CD, and production operations.

**E. Data Governance & Microsoft Purview**

* Experience with Microsoft Purview for data discovery, cataloging, metadata management, and governance is preferred.
* Understanding of enterprise data governance frameworks, policies, and standards.
* Experience with technical and business metadata, data lineage, data classification, and business glossary management.
* Knowledge of data ownership, data stewardship, and governance responsibilities.
* Familiarity with identifying and classifying sensitive data, including Personally Identifiable Information (PII).
* Understanding of data access policies, RBAC, least-privilege principles, and sensitive data protection.
* Knowledge of data lifecycle management, retention policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Familiarity with governance integrations across Databricks, Snowflake, and cloud data services.
* Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog and Snowflake governance capabilities is an advantage.

**F. Cloud Technologies**

Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform:

* **AWS:** Amazon S3, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, Amazon Redshift, and Amazon EMR.
* **Microsoft Azure:** Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Databricks, and Azure Synapse Analytics.
* **Google Cloud Platform:** BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Dataflow.

Experience integrating cloud services with Databricks, Snowflake, and Apache Airflow is preferred.

**G. Databases & Data Modeling**

* Experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, or other relational databases.
* Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, star schemas, snowflake schemas, and slowly changing dimensions.
* Familiarity with Parquet, Avro, JSON, and other common data formats.
* Understanding of data warehouses, data lakes, and lakehouse architectures.

**H. DevOps, CI/CD & Engineering Practices**

* Experience with Git and version control.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment automation.
* Knowledge of Docker, logging, monitoring, alerting, and production support.
* Experience managing deployments across development, testing, and production environments.

**4. Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working across Databricks and Snowflake within enterprise data platforms.
* Experience orchestrating multi-stage data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
* Microsoft Purview implementation, configuration, or administration experience.
* Knowledge of dbt, Fivetran, Airbyte, or similar data integration tools.
* Exposure to Power BI, Tableau, or other business intelligence platforms.
* Understanding of GDPR, CCPA, and other applicable data privacy and compliance requirements.
* Experience preparing governed, high-quality datasets for AI, machine learning, and LLM-based applications.
* Experience with data platform modernization, migration, and performance optimization.

**5. Certifications — Good to Have**

* **Databricks:** Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional.
* **Snowflake:** SnowPro Core Certification or a relevant SnowPro Advanced certification, particularly SnowPro Advanced: Data Engineer.

**6. Experience & Qualifications**

* Minimum 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or a closely related role.
* Strong hands-on experience building and supporting production data pipelines.
* Practical experience with Databricks, Snowflake, and Apache Airflow.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform and modern data engineering architectures.
* Understanding of enterprise data governance, data quality, and security principles.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**7. Key Competencies**

* Strong ownership of data engineering deliverables.
* Ability to design scalable, secure, and maintainable data solutions.
* Strong understanding of data governance and data quality principles.
* Excellent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Commitment to engineering quality, documentation, security, and continuous improvement.

#### **What We Offer**

* Opportunities to work with modern data platforms, including Databricks and Snowflake.
* Exposure to Apache Airflow orchestration and enterprise data governance using Microsoft Purview.
* Opportunities to contribute to data platform architecture and technical decision-making.
* Collaborative engineering environment and professional development opportunities.

title: Senior Manager, Application Development
description:
**Roles and Responsibilities**
==============================

* Frame ambiguous R&D and regulatory questions as well-posed modeling problems, selecting the appropriate method — classification, sequence modeling, information extraction, retrieval, generation, or statistical inference — and justifying the choice against alternatives.
* Build and evaluate NLP and LLM systems over large corpora of scientific and regulatory text: document parsing and layout-aware extraction, named entity and relation extraction, semantic search and reranking, retrieval-augmented generation, structured output, and multi-step agent orchestration with tool use.
* Develop predictive and statistical models over structured scientific data — analytical method and stability data, formulation and process parameters, historical submission outcomes — including feature engineering, handling of small and imbalanced datasets, uncertainty quantification, and model interpretability.
* Mine historical health authority correspondence (deficiency letters, information requests, complete response letters) to learn recurring deficiency patterns and build submission risk-scoring models.
* Design and own the evaluation discipline for every system shipped: curated golden datasets, inter-annotator agreement, failure taxonomies, offline and online metrics, A/B and regression testing, and quantitative acceptance criteria agreed with the business.
* Build reusable modeling components — embedding and retrieval pipelines, extraction schemas, evaluation harnesses, fine-tuning and prompt-optimization workflows — on Databricks (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, MLflow, Mosaic AI) and cloud model services (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker).
* Operationalize models with monitoring for data drift, performance degradation, and cost, and own remediation and periodic retraining.
* Produce audit-quality technical documentation — model cards, data lineage, validation evidence — supporting Amneal's GxP AI validation framework and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements, working with QA on inspection readiness.
* Establish benefit baselines with R&D and Regulatory owners and measure realized cycle-time, accuracy, and capacity outcomes.
* Present methods, results, limitations, and trade-offs to technical and business audiences; mentor junior scientists and engineers on modeling practice.

  

**3. Qualification and Experience**
===================================

**Education**

* MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computational Linguistics, or a related quantitative field; PhD preferred (exception, Bachelors from Tier-1 colleges).

**Required Experience**

* 5+ years building and deploying machine learning and NLP models in production, with demonstrated ownership from problem framing through monitoring.
* Deep applied knowledge of modern ML and NLP: transformer architectures, embeddings, fine-tuning and parameter-efficient methods, retrieval-augmented generation, structured extraction, and LLM/agent evaluation.
* Strong statistical foundations: experimental design, hypothesis testing, uncertainty quantification, and modeling with small, noisy, or imbalanced datasets.
* Expert-level Python and the scientific ML stack (PyTorch or similar, Hugging Face, scikit-learn, pandas/PySpark); strong SQL.
* Hands-on experience building agentic systems: multi-step orchestration, tool and function calling, and human-in-the-loop evaluation.
* Track record of designing rigorous evaluation frameworks and defending model quality with quantitative evidence.
* Ability to work within documented, controlled processes and produce audit-quality technical documentation.

**Preferred Experience**

* Document intelligence over long, technical, or scientific documents (OCR, layout parsing, table and figure extraction from legacy PDFs).
* Predictive modeling over chemistry, analytical, or process data; cheminformatics or chemometrics toolchains.
* Experience in a GxP-regulated or other validated environment; familiarity with 21 CFR Part 11, CSV, or GAMP 5 and with AI model validation or governance.
* Exposure to pharmaceutical regulatory content — ANDA/NDA/DMF, eCTD structure, SPL labeling, health authority correspondence. Not required; domain is taught on the job.
* Databricks (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, MLflow, Mosaic AI) and Amazon Bedrock or SageMaker.
* Publications, open-source contributions, or competition results demonstrating applied ML depth.

title: Manager - Technical Bid & Solution
description:
**Manager - Technical Bid & Solution**
======================================

**Role:**
=========

This is not a traditional Project Manager position. We are not looking for someone whose primary strength is maintaining Jira boards, scheduling meetings or updating project plans. We need someone who can read a 150-page government RFP and determine what Dash would actually have to build, migrate, integrate, test, deploy, support and manage if we win. The ideal person can move comfortably between technical and business conversations, challenge unrealistic assumptions, coordinate architects and engineers, build a credible delivery plan and make sure the proposal never promises something the delivery team cannot execute.

**Technical RFP Analysis**
==========================

* Analyze technical RFP requirements and decompose them into capabilities, workstreams, deliverables and dependencies.
* Identify mandatory technical requirements, integrations, security requirements, environments, data considerations, service levels and implementation constraints.
* Develop technical questions and clarification requests where requirements are ambiguous.

**Solution Shaping**
====================

* Facilitate solution workshops with architects, developers, cloud/data specialists, project managers and other SMEs.
* Develop credible solution approaches for custom application development, modernization, cloud, data, AI, integration and managed-service engagements.
* Define scope boundaries, assumptions, dependencies and exclusions.
* Ensure proposed solutions are practical, supportable and aligned with Dash delivery capabilities.

**Estimation & Delivery Planning**
==================================

* Develop or coordinate work breakdown structures, staffing models, schedules, milestones and effort estimates.
* Validate whether the proposed team can realistically deliver within the requested schedule.
* Identify delivery risks and mitigation strategies and support pricing teams with clear resource, effort and timeline assumptions.

**Technical Proposal Development**
==================================

* Own or co-author technical approaches, implementation plans, transition plans, architecture narratives, project-management approaches and related proposal sections.
* Provide technical input to graphics, diagrams and solution architecture.
* Review technical proposal sections for accuracy, consistency and credibility.
* Participate in technical Red Team reviews.

**Presentations & Pursuit-to-Delivery Continuity**
==================================================

* Support oral presentations, technical demonstrations, solution-defense sessions and clarification responses.
* Lead structured technical handoff after award so delivery receives proposal assumptions, commitments, staffing models, milestones and risks.
* Track lessons learned from actual project delivery and feed them back into future estimates and proposal approaches.

**Reusable Solution Assets**
============================

* Develop reusable reference approaches for recurring SLED opportunities.
* Maintain solution patterns, estimation assumptions, team models and implementation approaches that can accelerate future pursuits.

**Required Experience & Skills**
================================

* 7-10+ years of experience across IT delivery, architecture, technical presales, solution consulting, bid management or technical project leadership.
* At least 3 years of meaningful involvement in RFP/RFI responses, presales or solutioning.
* Strong understanding of modern application development, cloud, integration, data and enterprise technology delivery.
* Ability to estimate teams, effort, timelines and implementation dependencies.
* Strong understanding of project risks, assumptions and delivery governance.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong professional writing and presentation skills and willingness to challenge unrealistic assumptions.

**Preferred Qualifications / Experience**
=========================================

* U.S. public-sector or government-bid experience.
* Experience with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
* PMP, Scrum, SAFe, cloud or architecture certifications.
* Experience with AI/ML, data platforms, application modernization or systems integration.
* Experience supporting fixed-price or deliverables-based IT services proposals.

**The Personality We Are Looking For**
======================================

* Wants to understand how things actually work rather than repeating buzzwords.
* Challenges an estimate that does not make sense.
* Is comfortable saying, "We should not promise this unless we can prove how we will deliver it."
* Connects commercial promises to delivery reality.
* Takes ownership from RFP analysis through award handoff.
* Can work effectively with strong technical personalities.
* Is practical, curious, organized and decisive.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within the first 90 days, major solution-based pursuits should have clearer scope, assumptions, estimates, staffing models, timelines and technical narratives, with stronger continuity between what Dash sells and what Dash ultimately delivers.

title: IT & Infrastructure Engineer
description:

Acting as the invoice of the customer and a bridge between business, technology, and design, you'll ensure our solutions deliver exceptional value and align with our strategic goals.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment.
* Background in user-centred design or platform-based product development.

**Requirements**

* Minimum 5 years of product management experience, preferably in SaaS or B2B software.
* Solid understanding of system architecture, APIs, databases, and enterprise software delivery.
* Strong grasp of project management methodologies and the product development lifecycle.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive results in a dynamic environment.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Hands-on experience with product analytics and project management tools (e.g., Zoho Projects, Jira, Trello, Asana).

title: Head of Delivery
description:
- Description

  The Head of Delivery owns every client engagement from signed SOW to renewal: scope, schedule, quality, margin and client satisfaction. This is a new leadership role, created to give our portfolio a single accountable owner as we scale AI-led and multi-system programs.

  You will run delivery as a business, not a reporting function. You own the delivery P&L, the delivery operating model, and the managers who run our accounts. You collaborate with the CEO, who owns client relationships and new business, and with the CTO, who owns technology strategy, architecture standards and engineering practices.

  Responsibilities

  **Portfolio and P&L**

  * Own delivery revenue, gross margin and utilization across all active engagements.
  * Run monthly portfolio reviews covering health, burn, forecast, risk and margin for every account.
  * Approve staffing plans and resource allocation across fixed-price, time-and-materials and dedicated-team models.
  * Cut revenue leakage: unbilled effort, scope creep, bench cost and write-offs.

  **Delivery operating model**

  * Define and enforce one delivery framework: governance cadence, status reporting, change control, RAID management and release readiness.
  * Set delivery KPIs and make them visible to leadership weekly.
  * Embed AI-assisted delivery practices (planning, estimation, testing, documentation) in collaboration with the CTO.
  * Standardize estimation so fixed-price bids reflect real delivery data.

  **Client delivery governance**

  * Act as the senior escalation point for delivery issues and recover at-risk programs.
  * Run delivery-side steering committees and quarterly reviews with client stakeholders, alongside the CEO.
  * Turn delivery performance into expansion: surface phase-2 and adjacent opportunities to the CEO.

  **Pre-sales support**

  * Validate scope, estimates, team shape and delivery risk on every proposal and SOW before it is signed.
  * Join solutioning calls for large or high-risk deals.

  **People and leadership**

  * Lead, hire and develop delivery and project managers; build a bench of account-level leaders.
  * Run performance reviews and succession planning for the delivery organization.
  * Work with HR and practice heads on capacity planning, skills mix and hiring forecasts.

  **Quality and compliance**

  * Ensure delivery meets security and compliance obligations (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2 where applicable) and client audit requirements.
  * Run post-mortems on failed milestones and drive the fixes into the framework.

  Required Skills

  * 10+ years in IT services or product engineering services, with 6+ years leading delivery across multiple concurrent client accounts.
  * Has owned a delivery organization of 150+ engineers.\
  * Direct P&L accountability: has been measured on margin and utilization, not only on schedule.
  * Has run fixed-price, time-and-materials and dedicated-team engagements and can explain where each one loses money.
  * Has delivered for enterprise clients in the US, UK, Europe or Middle East, including C-level stakeholder management.
  * Has turned around at least one failing program; can describe what was changed and the result.
  * Hands-on with delivery governance: estimation, change control, RAID, SOW review and resource planning tools.
  * Technical enough to challenge an architecture or estimate; engineering background strongly preferred.
  * Bachelor's degree in engineering or computer science.

  **Nice to have**

  * Delivery leadership on AI/ML, GenAI or data engineering programs taken to production.
  * Experience with Salesforce, SAP, NetSuite or HubSpot implementation programs.
  * Delivery for regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences or BFSI.
  * PMP, PgMP or equivalent; an MBA is a plus, not a substitute for delivery track record.
  * Has built a PMO or delivery excellence function from scratch.
